purpose: Collect and cross-check all publicly accessible information relevant to three active data enquiries: EarthScope HA10 metadata/calibration/provenance, UK Polar Data Centre Ascension bathymetry source data, and BGS Offshore/MEDIN Ascension bathymetry/backscatter/subseafloor coverage.

EARTHSCOPE_DH_2635.subject: HA10 hydroacoustic data enquiry: H10N1/H10S2 metadata, calibration and archive provenance

PDC_3872.subject: Request for source/high-resolution data underlying Ascension bathymetry compilation GB/NERC/BAS/PDC/01236

BGS_OFFSHORE.subject: Ascension / HA10 data request: bathymetry, backscatter and subseafloor coverage

agents.focus: Authoritative HA10 station identity and network metadata: network code, station/channel naming, public FDSN records and authoritative custodians.
queries: HA10 H10N1 H10S2 FDSN network IM metadata

agents.focus: Exact H10N/H10S hydrophone geometry: sensor positions, depths, triplet spacing/aperture and orientation/azimuth references.
queries: H10N H10S Ascension hydrophone coordinates depth 2 km spacing

agents.focus: HA10 instrument response and calibration lineage, including end-to-end calibration, calibration sequences, response removal practice, and H10S anomalies/crosstalk.
queries: HA10 hydrophone calibration response H10S crosstalk
CTBTO underwater system electronics calibration H10S

agents.focus: EarthScope waveform availability and archive chronology for H10N1/H10S2: start dates, channels, gaps, sampling rates, StationXML/miniSEED routes and known public limitations.
Public HA10 processed products and technical literature: IDC/CTBTO detections, calibrated spectrograms, T-wave/event products and reproducible processing references.
queries: HA10 Ascension IDC hydroacoustic detections calibrated spectrogram
HA10 Ascension T-wave CTBTO public data products

agents.focus: Independent literature cross-check of HA10 technical facts: installation chronology, depth, aperture, sampling rate, data availability and known channel failures.
queries: HA10 Ascension installed 2004 850 m 2 km 250 Hz

agents.focus: Canonical BAS/PDC record GB/NERC/BAS/PDC/01236: DOI, downloadable products, resolution, bounds, processing parameters, licence, provenance and lineage.
JR53-AMT11 source lineage: cruise inventory, multibeam/TOPAS acquisition, track, survey area, sound-velocity data, archive holdings and raw-data pointers.
queries: JR53 AMT11 cruise report multibeam TOPAS Ascension

agents.focus: JR287 lineage and any Ascension-relevant swath/track products: determine exactly what the cruise contributed to PDC/01236 and where source data live.
JR15001/AMT25 lineage: Ascension swath bathymetry, timing/track, multibeam system, CTD/sound-velocity context and raw archive pointers.
queries: JR15001 Ascension multibeam raw data BODC

agents.focus: JR16-NG lineage: Ascension/offshore seamount coverage, multibeam or mapping products, cruise report, tracklines and data custodians.
Find native-resolution or higher-resolution source grids/swath files underlying PDC/01236, plus per-cruise tracklines, coverage polygons, MB-System processing and any sound-velocity metadata.
queries: Ascension Island native multibeam swath bathymetry raw MB-System
Ascension Island survey tracklines JR53 JR287 JR15001 JR16-NG

agents.focus: BGS Offshore GeoIndex and NGDC/MEDIN holdings around H10N1/H10S2: bathymetry, geophysics, survey lines, boreholes/samples where relevant, and dataset identifiers.
queries: BGS Offshore GeoIndex Ascension Island bathymetry

agents.focus: Backscatter availability around Ascension from BGS/BODC/BAS source cruises: mosaics, raw backscatter, multibeam ancillary products and data access paths.
Sub-bottom profiler, TOPAS and seismic-reflection coverage in the Ascension/HA10/Mid-Atlantic Ridge region; identify cruises, tracklines, reports and custodians.
queries: Ascension Fracture Zone seismic reflection cruise
Ascension Island marine seismic BODC BGS

agents.focus: Independent verifier: cross-check whether H10N1 and H10S2 coordinates fall inside each discovered dataset/survey footprint; flag coordinate mismatch, resolution mismatch and unsupported claims.
queries: Ascension Island bathymetry survey bounds 14.48 W 7.845 S

agents.focus: Cross-track custodian and gap map: deduplicate all discoverable authoritative repositories, technical reports, DOI/catalog IDs and likely next custodians; explicitly separate FOUND, POINTER_ONLY, NOT_FOUND and NEEDS_CUSTODIAN_REPLY.
queries: HA10 Ascension hydroacoustic data custodian EarthScope CTBTO
Ascension bathymetry BODC BAS PDC BGS MEDIN raw swath
Ascension Island marine geophysics data archive
